unlisted_practices: Ontology-aware hybrid retrieval and constrained LLM reasoning in an agentic workflow for standardizing laboratory terms to LOINC
Linguistic normalization before terminology mapping to support cross-lingual semantic interoperability

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an agentic LLM framework (LabBridge) for standardizing clinical laboratory test names to LOINC codes, testing performance on retrospective benchmark datasets without evaluating organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
